title: Matt Mullenweg reportedly returns as Automattic CEO 2 days after getting booted
summary: Matt Mullenweg, founder of WordPress and CEO of Automattic, was reportedly removed from his position only to return as CEO just 2 days later, indicating significant internal turmoil at the company that powers WordPress.com and contributes heavily to the open-source WordPress project.
problem_solved: This news item reports on corporate leadership instability at Automattic, not a technical problem being solved.
why_valuable: It provides insight into the leadership dynamics of one of the largest contributors to open-source web publishing software, affecting millions of websites.
